LESSON: BOOK HANDLING READING

Grade: PP1
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.1: Book handling READING

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Book handling READING. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: when and out of school. right to left. reading?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Book handling READING
2. Practise Book handling READING at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Book handling READING

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Book handling READING
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Book handling READING. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Book handling READING at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Book handling READING at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Book handling READING
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Book handling READING. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Book handling READING using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Book handling READING in the examples.
2. Explain Book handling READING to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Book handling READING.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Book handling READING using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Book handling READING important for a PP1 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Sing rhymes related to handling and storage holding books top side up and turning activities in and out of pages from right to left. school.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. when and out of school. right to left. reading?
2. when reading?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Book handling READING
2. Practise Book handling READING at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Book handling READING

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
